giver: Hunters' lodge: fletchers in every village (pooled representatives); in Reece, Huntmistress Orla Vance, master of the lodge. Mentor: Old Tobiah, a superstitious retired tracker.
feel: The hunt: reading tracks, stalking game across every biome, long shots and thrown steel, and trophies for the lodge wall, building to legendary named beasts.

quests.title: Bow and Oath
quests.summary: Huntmistress Vance won't take a hunter who can't make their own gear: craft a bow and a quiver's worth of arrows and swear the lodge oath (never waste a kill).
quests.reward: Range XP, a lodge armband and arrows

quests.title: First Tracks
quests.summary: A fletcher shows you how to follow hoof prints through the woods: track deer and take venison and an antler.

quests.title: Bullseye
quests.summary: At the lodge's range, put ten arrows into target blocks at increasing distances before the candle burns down.

quests.title: Tusks in the Turnips
quests.summary: Wild boars are tearing up a village's fields; hunt down the sounder before it ruins the harvest, and keep the bushmeat.

quests.title: Thrown Steel
quests.summary: Old Tobiah swears by thrown weapons: craft iron throwing knives, a tomahawk and javelins and make a kill with each.

quests.title: The Lookout
quests.summary: The lodge keeps a lookout in a firewatch tower deep in the forest; climb it, meet the watcher and mark three game trails from the top.

quests.title: The Longbow
quests.summary: From the tower, the watcher points out a deer far below: craft a Spartan longbow and drop it with one shot from the top.
quests.reward: Range XP, a large arrow quiver

quests.title: The Silent Camp
quests.summary: A hunting party's camp has gone quiet. Find it, follow the claw marks and rescue the last hunter from the tree where a grizzly bear has kept him for two days.

quests.title: Odd Coats
quests.summary: The lodge collects strange pelts and bones: bring down three different variants of zombies, spiders or skeletons with arrows and bring proof of each.
quests.reward: Range XP, a tipped arrow bundle

quests.title: Bolts at Night
quests.summary: Some nights call for a heavier weapon: craft a heavy crossbow and bolts and drop twenty skeletons before dawn.

quests.title: Tobiah's Hat
quests.summary: Old Tobiah never hunted without his lucky hat, and only passes it to someone who brings him trophies from three different beasts: a moose antler, a crocodile scute and a gazelle horn. Luck, he says, follows the hat.

quests.title: The Long Grass
quests.summary: In the savanna the hunter becomes the hunted: track a lion pride and a rhino and take their hides without being charged.
quests.reward: Range XP, a diamond arrow bundle

quests.title: Stripes in the Shade
quests.summary: A tiger has been stalking a jungle village; sneak through the undergrowth without being spotted and take it before it takes you.

quests.title: Coils in the Swamp
quests.summary: A villager's boat was dragged under by an anaconda; hunt it in the swamp and bring back its shed skin for the lodge.

quests.title: Ghost of the Peaks
quests.summary: High in the snowy peaks, find the tracks of a snow leopard and a froststalker and bring down the froststalker for its horn.
quests.reward: Range XP, a froststalker horn helmet

quests.title: The Long Shot
quests.summary: Tobiah bets you can't hit a target from fifty blocks across a ravine; prove him wrong with a longbow.

quests.title: The Rival Lodge
quests.summary: A rival lodge from a far village claims the best hunters; a contest at a logging camp: most game taken with bow and thrown weapons in one day.

quests.title: Vultures of the Valley
quests.summary: The Nether has game too: shoot soul vultures out of the sky over a soul sand valley and take a soul heart.

quests.title: The Serpent in the Lava
quests.summary: Lava lakes hide a bone serpent; lure it out and bring it down from the shore before it pulls you in. Its tooth goes on the lodge wall.
quests.reward: Range XP, a bone serpent tooth

quests.title: The Warped Swarm
quests.summary: A crimson mosquito fed on warped fungus and grew into a monster; track it to its warped forest and shoot it down.
quests.reward: Range XP, warped muscle and a netherite arrow bundle

quests.title: The Trophy Hall
quests.summary: The lodge in Reece needs a hall worthy of its hunters: build it and hang five trophies, from bear to wolf.
quests.reward: Range XP, a mounted bear trophy

quests.title: A Bow for the End
quests.summary: Forge a netherite longbow and a huge arrow quiver for the hunts to come.

quests.title: Swarm Out of the Void
quests.summary: In the End, enderiophage swarms drift between the islands; thin them out with arrows and keep your feet on the edge.

quests.title: Old Ironhide
quests.summary: First of the legendary beasts: a rhinoceros the size of a hut, its hide stopping ordinary arrows; find Old Ironhide on the plains and take him.

quests.title: The Grey Widow
quests.summary: Second legend: a tarantula hawk that hunts travellers in the desert, faster in the air than any arrow you've fired. Take its wing.
quests.reward: Range XP, a tarantula hawk wing

quests.title: The White Stag
quests.summary: The last legend: a white stag seen once a generation. Track it across three biomes, and when it falls, hang its antlers on the lodge's golden hook, which Vance then gives to you.

quests.title: Crabs of Amethyst
quests.summary: Something has been crystallising beaches: find the amethyst nest and bring down its amethyst crab from range.

quests.title: Huntmaster
quests.summary: With every legend on the wall and a thousand kills at range, Vance names you Huntmaster and gives you the lodge's own bow.
quests.reward: Range XP, Vance's Whisper (netherite longbow: Power V, Infinity, Unbreaking III, Flame)
